name: ViT deepfake-vs-real per-frame (video-frames runtime)
reason: Inner model measured locally and rejected for manipulation detection (AUROC ~0.51 on face-focused SBI, ~47% FPR on aged portraits). See experiments/FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md.
limitations: Downloads the ~330 MB ViT snapshot on first use plus opencv for frame decoding.
crop_faces scores each detected face crop per sampled frame — frames without a detectable face are skipped, so a faceswap confined to frames the detector misses will dilute coverage.
Frame-level mean aggregation, not temporal detection — a manipulation present in few frames may dilute below threshold.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
notes: The 'inner' profile is a complete image-runtime profile; crop_faces applies per sampled frame through the standard profile path.
'frames' evenly spaced frames are decoded to temp PNGs and scored; the aggregate is the mean and 'models[]' reports each frame's score.
